project.title: IOQM Grade 9 Algebra - Concept Assimilation Guide
project.routing_policy: Because the diagnostic was explicitly skipped, Part 0 uses conservative profile-only routing and never labels any concept mastered from the 50% self-report.

syllabus_items: Polynomials in two variables via symmetric/cyclic compression
scope.teaching_order_basis: concept prerequisites and recognition/representation/first-move signatures, not Appendix A order

concepts.name: Identities and manufactured factorisation
concepts.representation: Manufacture a factorization whose factors expose divisibility, sign or squares.

concepts.name: Equation legality and engineered rational simplification
concepts.representation: Track excluded values first; replace full denominator clearing by a common numerator/factor when the expression is engineered.

concepts.name: Linear totals, averages and consecutive-block translation
concepts.representation: Replace raw lists by count, total, extremes and consecutive-block sums.

concepts.name: Sum-product compression in two variables
concepts.representation: Compress a symmetric pair to s=x+y and p=xy; rebuild targets from s,p.

concepts.name: Three-variable symmetry and cyclic method selection
concepts.representation: Choose among s,q,r; a common value k; p=xyz; or cyclic orientation before algebra.

concepts.name: Quadratic root classification and repeated-root geometry
concepts.representation: Translate root-language to discriminant or repeated-root equations, then use geometry/global shape when degree >2.

concepts.name: Polynomial difference, Vieta, root sums and preimage thinking
concepts.representation: Use P(x)-P(a), Vieta/root sums, P'/P, multiplicity counting, or quadratic preimage pairing according to the output/root surface.

concepts.name: Symmetric poles and midpoint shifts
concepts.representation: Center symmetric poles with t=x-c; pair reciprocals; if even in t, use u=t^2.

concepts.name: Inequalities, smoothing and ordered-mass bounds
concepts.representation: Freeze one variable or one mass budget, reduce to a one-variable/boundary problem, and prove equality is attainable.

concepts.name: AP, GP, HP and mixed progression structure
concepts.representation: Parameterize AP/GP structure with the minimum variables; use convergence and divisibility before enumeration; HP is reciprocal-AP.

concepts.name: Finite differences and recurrence structure
concepts.representation: Look for degree via differences or a shift/period identity before computing many terms.

concepts.name: Exponent substitutions, radicals and algebraic irrational bases
concepts.representation: Replace common exponential blocks by a positive variable; compare irrational basis components exactly rather than numerically.

concepts.name: Polynomial functional identities
concepts.representation: Exploit an identity holding for every input to determine degree and coefficients; enforce nested-value self-consistency.

concepts.name: Integer and discrete filters
concepts.representation: Replace ordered integers by gaps or roots, then use divisibility/bounds/inclusion-exclusion to make the search finite.

concepts.name: Binomial theorem and coefficient bridge
concepts.representation: Read coefficients structurally from (x+y)^n; use symmetry and adjacent-binomial identities instead of expansion.

qa.answer_leakage_policy: Answers only in Appendix D; Core worked examples are author-created teaching examples.
